/**
 * @name Insecure JWT validation
 * @description Using JWT without proper validation or with insecure algorithms
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-jwt
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-345
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("jwt").getMember(["decode", "encode"]).getACall()
select call, "JWT operation found. Ensure proper algorithm validation and signature verification."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure JWT validation could lead to authentication bypass

/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description Using regex patterns vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "findall", "finditer"]).getACall()
select call, "Regular expression operation found. Check for patterns vulnerable to ReDoS (exponential backtracking)."
findings.hypothesis: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerabilities in regex patterns used for URI validation
